description: This Swift source file defines a singleton class KeychainStore, which provides secure storage and retrieval functionalities for credentials and tokens using the iOS Keychain services. It includes methods to set, get, and remove string data associated with predefined keys, handling keychain query configuration and error management.

classes.name: KeychainStore
classes.description: A singleton class providing secure storage for tokens and related data using the iOS Keychain.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Stores a string in the Keychain for a specified key, encoding the string as UTF-8 data.

methods.name: getString
methods.description: Retrieves a string from the Keychain corresponding to a specified key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry associated with the specified key from the Keychain.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all predefined token entries from the Keychain.
